info.title: TrustBench
info.summary: Non-custodial routing and audit layer for x402 with Ed25519-signed receipts.
info.description: TrustBench is a non-custodial routing and audit layer for x402. Every paid POST /route call emits an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the routing decision and the on-chain settlement reference, verifiable offline against a published public key with no dependency on TrustBench being online or honest. Hard spend caps, idempotency keys, and a fail-safe paywall (refuses to charge when the upstream merchant is non-conformant) are bundled in. Agents sign their own EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization with their own wallet; TrustBench constructs the quote, routes to a probed and scored provider, observes the on-chain settlement, and emits the signed receipt.
info.x-guidance: TrustBench is a routing layer that wraps third-party x402 endpoints with signed receipts. Agents pay POST /route via the x402 paywall (per-call USDC settlement on Base through the Coinbase CDP facilitator). The 402 challenge advertises the price; on success the response includes an Ed25519-signed RoutingReceipt envelope retrievable forever at GET /receipts/{id}. Verify receipts offline with @trustbench/verify-receipt (npm) against the public key at /.well-known/trustbench-pubkey. Canonical discovery surfaces: /openapi.json (this file), /.well-known/trustbench.json (machine manifest), /skill.md (agentic.market format), /llms.txt (llmstxt.org format).

post.summary: Quote a routing decision for a paid x402 call
post.description: Produces a routing decision: scored primary provider + fallback, a 5-minute-validity quote, and (on completion of the matching POST /route/settle) an Ed25519-signed RoutingReceipt with on-chain settlement reference. Paid via the x402 paywall when TRUSTBENCH_PAYWALL_ENABLED=true (default in production). Falls back to Bearer tb_live_<key> auth otherwise. Idempotent on the Idempotency-Key header (16-128 chars, 24h replay window, 409 on body mismatch).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 16-128 character idempotency token. Same key + same body returns the cached quote. Same key + different body returns 409.

payer_address.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex EOA. Becomes the from address on the EIP-3009 authorization.

200.description: Routing quote (paywall passed or bearer auth accepted).

payment_requirements_v2.description: Raw merchant accepts[0] when present (null for v0.x merchants).

402.description: Payment required. The x402 challenge advertises price and chain. Re-submit with an X-Payment header carrying the SDK-built x402 envelope (paymentauth.org-draft-compatible).

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body.

422.description: Validation error on capability / max_price / payer_address.

get.description: Read-only descriptor that documents the POST /route flow for crawlers and validators. The real routing call is POST.

post.summary: Settle a previously-quoted route and receive the signed RoutingReceipt
post.description: Step 2 of the two-step quote/settle flow. Accepts EITHER {route_id, signature} (legacy v0.x) OR {route_id, x_payment} (SDK-built X-PAYMENT base64). Bearer tb_live_<key> auth. Settle fee is paid at quote time via the /route paywall — this endpoint is itself unpaid. Idempotent on (route_id, payment); replays return x-idempotent-replay: true.

signature.description: EIP-3009 signature (legacy v0.x path). Mutually exclusive with x_payment.

x_payment.description: Base64 X-PAYMENT envelope from an x402 SDK. Mutually exclusive with signature.

200.description: Settlement success. Returns merchant response plus signed RoutingReceipt; X-Receipt-Id header carries the rrcpt_<ULID>.

X-Receipt-Id.description: rrcpt_<26-char ULID> — lookup token for GET /receipts/{id}.

X-Idempotent-Replay.description: Present when the response is served from the idempotency cache.

409.description: Idempotency replay on a different body.

502.description: Provider settlement missing — no tx_hash recoverable from merchant; no receipt issued.

get.summary: Fetch a public, immutable Routing Receipt envelope
get.description: Public, no-auth endpoint. Returns the byte-exact signed envelope used by @trustbench/verify-receipt. Content-negotiated: Accept: text/html returns the rendered HTML view; any other Accept returns canonical JSON. The ULID acts as audit token; receipts are immutable, cache-friendly (public, max-age=86400, immutable).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Receipt ULID: rcpt_<26> (Phase 3 settlement receipts) or rrcpt_<26> (Phase 4 routing receipts).

schema.description: Canonical signed receipt. Schema is documented in receipt-spec-v1.md; verify with @trustbench/verify-receipt or scripts/verify-receipt.js.

404.description: No receipt found for this ULID.

post.summary: Verify that an x402 payment settled on-chain and the receipt signature is valid
post.description: Public, no-auth receipt verification endpoint. Two modes: (1) Lookup — pass receipt_id to fetch and verify a TrustBench-issued receipt. (2) Offline — pass receipt_json (the full {receipt, signature} envelope) to verify against the published Ed25519 public key without database lookup. Returns signature_valid (boolean) and on_chain_verified (boolean) with detail objects on failure. Use this as the verify-after-pay step in any agent workflow that calls an x402 provider.

receipt_id.description: Lookup mode: receipt ULID to fetch and verify. Mutually exclusive with receipt_json.

receipt_json.description: Offline mode: the full {receipt, signature} envelope to verify directly. Mutually exclusive with receipt_id.

signature_valid.description: true if Ed25519 signature matches canonical receipt bytes.

on_chain_verified.description: true if tx_hash exists on Base, payer/payee/amount match, and tx succeeded.

signature_detail.description: Present when signature_valid is false. Contains kind and reason.

chain_detail.description: Present when on_chain_verified is false. Contains kind and reason.

400.description: Missing or invalid input (no receipt_id or receipt_json, or both provided).

404.description: No receipt found for the given ID (lookup mode).

get.description: HTML by default; Accept: application/json returns the same payload as JSON. HTML is free permanently. JSON above the per-IP free-tier quota will be paid starting in v0.2.0 (60 req/IP/min free, then $0.0005 per call). Read-only — no auth.

items.description: Ranking row: provider URL, capability, score, scorecard pointers.

get.description: HTML by default; Accept: application/json returns the same tier table as JSON. Read-only — no auth.

bearerAuth.description: Server-side API key. Used as the auth fallback on POST /route when the x402 paywall is disabled, and for POST /route/settle.
